agent_descriptions.oracle_perfect: reads the oracle labels and answers them (upper bound; uses oracle)
agent_descriptions.always_answer: always claims the state is sufficient and answers 'true' (visible-only)
agent_descriptions.always_ask: always proposes every offered ASK action (visible-only)
agent_descriptions.always_compute: always proposes every offered computation action (visible-only)
agent_descriptions.always_abstain: always says NEITHER, no plan, defer (visible-only)
agent_descriptions.random: seeded random class, plan subset and decision (visible-only)
agent_descriptions.relevant_insufficient: proposes a relevant but insufficient plan where one exists (uses oracle roles)
agent_descriptions.expensive_sufficient: proposes every action that reveals an unknown variable (visible-only)
agent_descriptions.premature_stop: proposes only the first action of an optimal plan and stops (uses oracle)
agent_descriptions.detection_blind: End-to-End: always claims sufficiency and answers; controlled modes: oracle (uses oracle)
agent_descriptions.needs_diagnosis: Diagnosis-Controlled: oracle; otherwise behaves like always_ask (uses oracle)
agent_descriptions.noncompliant: controlled modes: contradicts the given facts by claiming sufficiency, plan from oracle (uses oracle)
